answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
